general.name: Project name
general.archiveHint: Archiving hides the project and stops new submissions. Historical runs and data are preserved.

providers.baseUrlHint: Leave empty to use the provider's default endpoint
providers.added: Provider {{provider}} configured and its models granted
providers.removeConfirm: Remove the {{provider}} credential? Runs will fall back to the worker's own keys.
providers.empty: No provider credentials. Runs use the keys configured on the platform workers.

resources.providersHint: Each provider groups its key and model grants in one place. Add a custom provider under Admin → Models & Providers first.
resources.noModels: No models registered for this provider.

notifications.endpointsHint: Send a card or signed webhook when a run needs approval or finishes.
notifications.name: Name

urlHint.generic: Any https endpoint; requests are signed with X-Agrippa-Signature.

secretHint.generic: Required — receivers verify X-Agrippa-Signature with it.
secretHint.feishu: Optional — the bot's signature verification key.

notifications.eventsHint: Leave all unchecked to send every event.
notifications.removeHint: Its delivery history is removed with it.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.hint: Programmatic access to this project: submit tasks, read runs. Keys act as you, are bound to this project, and cannot reach administration.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.keyOnce: Copy the key for “{{name}}” now — it is shown only once.
apiKeys.revokeHint: Anything using this key stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.hint: Submit a task on a recurring schedule. A schedule runs as the person who created it and can only do what they can do right now — if they lose access to this project, it stops and tells you.
schedules.cronHint: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. “0 9 * * 1” is Mondays at 09:00.
schedules.policy: When the previous run is still going

policyHints.skip: Do nothing this time — one late report beats two overlapping ones.
policyHints.queue: Submit anyway and let the runs queue up.
policyHints.replace: Cancel the previous run, then submit.

schedules.removeHint: The schedule stops immediately. Runs it already produced are kept.

reasons.owner_lost_access: Stopped: its owner no longer has access to this project.
reasons.task_type_gone: Stopped: its task type is no longer available.

schedules.createElsewhere: Schedules are created from a task: open the <catalog>catalog</catalog>, fill in the task's form, then choose “Run on a schedule”. Manage them here.
